fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Claude is the default and the best supported. OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini's compatible endpoint and local models served by Ollama, vLLM or LM Studio, so data can stay on your own servers.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Stored encrypted; never sent to the browser. A local model server may not need one.

fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Claude: leave as is unless you use a gateway. OpenAI-compatible: the URL ending in /v1, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Model ID as the provider names it, for example claude-opus-5-5 or claude-sonnet-5-5. Use Test Connection to list the models your key can use. With other providers choose a model that supports tool calling.

fields.label: Reasoning Effort
fields.description: Leave blank to use the model default. Higher effort is slower and uses more tokens.

fields.label: Execution Mode
fields.description: Background Worker is recommended. Use Inline only on sites that run without background workers.

fields.label: Prompt Caching
fields.description: Reduces cost and latency on long conversations. Turn off if your gateway rejects the cache_control field.

fields.label: Model for Conversation Titles
fields.description: A small, fast model used only to name conversations. Leave blank to skip automatic titles.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Square image, shown in the launcher and chat header.

fields.label: Launcher Position
fields.description: Hidden removes the floating button; the assistant still opens with Ctrl+. and from its page.

fields.label: Tell Users Which AI Model Is Used
fields.description: When off, the assistant introduces itself only by the name above.

fields.label: Welcome Title
fields.default: How can I help you today?

fields.label: Welcome Message
fields.default: Ask about your data, request a report, or get help with anything.

fields.label: Suggested Prompts
fields.description: One per line. Shown as shortcuts on the welcome screen.
fields.default:
Show me sales by month for this year as a chart
Which customers have overdue invoices?
Build a report of stock below reorder level
Summarise the document I am looking at

fields.label: Company Instructions
fields.description: Standing instructions for every conversation: tone, terminology, fiscal year rules, what to avoid.

fields.label: Allow Read-only SQL
fields.description: Lets permitted users have the assistant run SELECT queries for analysis that needs joins. SQL does not apply row-level User Permissions, so limit it to trusted roles.

fields.label: Allow Saving Reports
fields.description: The assistant drafts and previews a report; it is saved only when the user clicks Save.

fields.label: Roles Allowed to Save Query Reports
fields.description: Query Reports contain SQL. Other users can still save Report Builder reports, which follow normal permissions.

fields.label: Add Saved Reports to a Workspace
Allow Creating and Updating Documents
fields.description: Every change is shown to the user first and runs with their own permissions only after they confirm.

fields.label: Allow Drafting Emails
fields.description: The assistant can prepare an email. The user sees recipients, subject and text on a card and it is sent only when they confirm.

fields.label: Never Change These DocTypes
fields.description: The assistant will not propose creating, changing, submitting, cancelling or deleting documents of these types.

fields.label: Writing Help on Form Fields
fields.description: Adds a small button to long text fields: fix spelling, translate Arabic and English, improve, make formal, shorten. The user always sees a preview first.

fields.label: Allow Web Search
fields.description: Lets the assistant look up current information online. Billed by your AI provider per search.

fields.label: Remember Across Conversations
fields.description: The assistant can suggest notes to remember (preferences, business rules). A personal note is saved when the user accepts it; a company-wide note also needs a System Manager's approval.

fields.label: Find Notes by Meaning
fields.description: Without this, notes are found by shared words. With it, each note and each question is sent to an embeddings service so that 'revenue' also finds a note about 'sales'. Claude has no embeddings service, so this needs another provider or a local model.

fields.label: Embeddings Model
fields.description: For example text-embedding-3-small (OpenAI) or nomic-embed-text (Ollama).

fields.label: Embeddings API Base URL
fields.description: OpenAI-compatible URL ending in /v1.

fields.label: Check Figures Against Query Results
fields.description: Large numbers in an answer are matched against what the queries returned. If one cannot be traced, the assistant is asked to recompute it, and the answer is flagged if it still cannot be traced.

fields.label: Second-opinion Review of Report Drafts
fields.description: Before a SQL report draft is shown, a separate review pass looks for logic errors (double counting, missing filters). Its notes appear on the draft. Uses one extra AI request per draft.

fields.label: Allow Scheduled Tasks
fields.description: Users can have a question answered on a schedule and emailed to them. Needs the scheduler and outgoing email to be working.

fields.label: Allow Triggering Automations
fields.description: Lets the assistant start workflows you register under AI Assistant Automation (for example n8n webhooks). Every run needs the user's confirmation.

fields.label: Where the AI Provider Runs
fields.options:
Outside (external service)
Inside the country
On our own servers
fields.description: Your statement of where the configured provider processes data. The list on the right is enforced only for an outside service.

fields.label: Mask Personal Data
fields.description: Email addresses, phone numbers, IBANs, card numbers and Saudi ID / Iqama numbers are replaced with placeholders before text is sent to the AI provider, and put back in the answer. Names, images and PDF pages are not masked.

fields.label: Sensitive DocTypes
fields.description: Records of these types (for example Employee, Salary Slip) are never read for an outside AI provider. They stay available when the provider runs inside the country or on your own servers.

fields.label: Answer from the Knowledge Library
fields.description: Lets the assistant search the documents you add under AI Assistant Knowledge (policies, manuals, procedures) and name the document it used.

fields.label: Check Entries When They Are Saved
fields.description: Runs the rules under AI Assistant Check Rule on every save and submit: duplicates, unusual prices and amounts, wrong dates, missing data. These checks are fixed rules; they do not call the AI provider.

fields.label: Control Room
fields.description: A page that counts what needs attention in sales, purchasing, accounts, stock, projects and HR, and lists what is waiting for approval.

fields.label: Scheduled Tasks May Prepare Actions for Approval
fields.description: A scheduled task marked for it can prepare documents and emails. They wait in the Control Room until a person approves each one; nothing is created or sent before that.

fields.label: Daily Messages per User
fields.description: 0 means unlimited.

fields.label: Messages per Minute per User
fields.description: Stops a script or a stuck page from running up cost. 0 means unlimited.

fields.label: Monthly Tokens per User
fields.description: Input plus output tokens a user may consume in a calendar month. 0 means unlimited. See the AI Assistant Usage report for actual use.

fields.label: Conversation Turns Kept in Context
fields.description: Older turns are summarised to keep cost down.

fields.label: Delete Conversations After (days)
fields.description: 0 keeps them forever.

fields.label: Keep an Audit Log of Data Access
